title: The Awakening of the Tianji Record
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji felt the power of the complete Tianji Record surge into his body, but at the same time, a voice rang in his ear: 'The date of death in Chapter 700 cannot be escaped'

text.content: On the fragmented pages, ancient characters began to slowly flow, as if a consciousness dormant for ten thousand years had finally awakened. Chen Ji heard an old and weary voice ring out in his Mental Sea: 'You've finally come, the Breaker of the Game.'

Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes to find himself in a vast and boundless Mental Sea. Around him, stars flowed ceaselessly, each point of light like an intersection of countless threads of fate. And at the very center of the Mental Sea, an ancient Jade Slip floated quietly, its characters slowly illuminating, like a colossal beast dormant for millennia finally opening its eyes.

dialogue.content: (Tianji Record Consciousness) 'I've been waiting for you for a very long time, the last bloodline of the Chen family. Ten thousand years of reincarnation, tangled karma, you've finally reached this point.'

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at the Jade Slip, feeling an ancient and profound aura wash over him. This wasn't the fragment he had seen before, but the complete Tianji Record itself, the light flowing upon it pulsing like a living creature.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji) 'Tianji Record... you've finally decided to reveal yourself. Tell me, what exactly are you? Why did you choose me?'

text.content: The Jade Slip slowly unfurled, and countless ancient runes bloomed in the Mental Sea like stars. Chen Ji saw blurry visions—battlefields from ten thousand years ago, waves of blood-colored light, and a figure forging upstream against the river of destiny.

dialogue.content: (Tianji Record Consciousness) 'I was originally a 'Weapon to Break the Game' refined by your Chen family ancestors, carrying the mission of rewriting the rules of heaven and breaking the shackles of fate. However, ten thousand years ago, another existence tampered with my foundation, turning me from a game-breaking weapon into... a shackle.'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart trembled, and the starlight in his Mental Sea seemed to sense something, fluctuating violently. He saw those visions—generations of inheritors using the Tianji Record's power, then perishing one by one in the vortex of fate, becoming discarded pieces on heaven's chessboard.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji) 'So you've been using us all along? Making every generation of inheritors your fuel?'

text.content: 'No.' The Tianji Record's voice carried a trace of sorrow, 'My tampered foundation forced me to act this way. But I never gave up waiting—waiting for a Chen family bloodline strong enough to complete the ancestors' unfinished plan to break the game.'

dialogue.content: (Tianji Record Consciousness) 'You're very special, Chen Ji. Your disposition, strategy, and will are the closest to the ancestors in ten thousand years. That's why I choose to awaken at this moment, showing you the complete truth.'

text.content: The runes on the Jade Slip began to spin wildly, and a brilliant pillar of light descended from the heavens, enveloping Chen Ji entirely. He felt a powerful force pouring into his body—that was the complete inheritance of the Tianji Record itself.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji) 'So this is... the complete Tianji Record?'

text.content: 'Yes and no.' The Tianji Record's voice grew serious, 'After merging, you will gain the complete 'Fate Writing' ability—you can rewrite any fate inscribed by heaven, including your own date of death.'

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji) 'And the price? There's no such thing as a free lunch in this world.'

text.content: A brief silence fell in the Mental Sea. Chen Ji could sense the Tianji Record hesitating, its consciousness rippling with complex emotions. Finally, the Tianji Record spoke again, its voice carrying a trace of apology.

dialogue.content: (Tianji Record Consciousness) 'The price of Fate Writing is that the scribe must bear all the karma of whoever is rewritten. This means—whosever's fate you rewrite, you must carry whosever's karma. The more you rewrite, the heavier the karma becomes, until...'

choice.prompt: The complete power of the Tianji Record lay before him, but the price was suffocatingly heavy. Chen Ji stood at the crossroads of fate, and his choice would determine everything.

choices.description: Accept all the complete power of the Tianji Record and gain Fate Writing ability, but karma backlash will follow like a shadow.
choices.visible_cost: Lose Heaven's protection, karma backlash intensifies
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete Tianji Record, Fate Writing ability

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his gaze turning resolute. "I choose to accept. Whatever the cost, I will break the shackles of this fate."

choices.description: Accept the power, but establish an equal partnership with the Tianji Record, sharing karmic consequences together, and seek methods to break the cost.
choices.visible_cost: The Tianji Record's will is bound to you; rise together, fall together.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete Tianji Record, establish a true partnership.
choices.risk_hint: Fate-writing ability is limited, requiring negotiation with the Tianji Record.

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze slightly hardened as he said in a deep voice: "I can accept the power, but I have one condition—from now on, we are partners, not master and servant. Shared karmic consequences, shared honor and disgrace."

choices.description: Refuse to merge with the Tianji Record, retain the current fragment abilities, continue seeking a path to break the situation without bearing karmic consequences.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the chance to obtain complete power
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the status quo, seek other possibilities
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may take the opportunity to strike

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, a cold smirk appearing at the corner of his mouth. "Complete power? Sounds beautiful, but I never believe there's a free lunch in this world. Tell me the real cost, otherwise I'd rather use the fragments to piece together my future bit by bit."

The pillar of light flowed through Chen Ji's body, bringing intense pain and transformation. His meridians were being reshaped, his Mental Sea was expanding, and the connection between him and the Tianji Record became unprecedentedly close.

dialogue.content: (Tianji Record consciousness) "Fusion complete. From now on, you are the complete master of the Tianji Record. The奥秘 of fate-writing is now in your Mental Sea, and the next step depends on how you use it."

text.content: Chen Ji felt unprecedented power flowing through his body. He could see the threads of fate, touch the veins of cause and effect, and even faintly glimpse a corner of the future. But at the same time, he also felt that heavy karmic backlash—with every use of power, an equivalent weight of karma would press upon him.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji) "I understand. It's like... swimming upstream against the river of fate. Every rewrite will be retaliated by the river."

text.content: "You're very clever, smarter than all previous inheritors." The Tianji Record's voice carried a trace of relief, "But I must warn you—the Heavenly Eye has already sensed our fusion. From now on, you will feel its gaze becoming clearer and clearer, more and more... oppressive."

Chen Ji raised his head, as if piercing through the boundaries of his Mental Sea and seeing those omnipresent eyes. It was watching, waiting, calculating—calculating when this new breaker of the game would, like his predecessors, become a discarded piece on the heavenly chessboard.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji) "The death deadline at Chapter 700... did you write that?"

text.content: The Tianji Record's consciousness rippled, carrying a trace of helplessness: "No, that was the original fate written by the Heavenly Eye. I cannot change it, nor can I erase it. But now, you possess the ability to write fate—perhaps you can rewrite it yourself."

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji) "But the cost is bearing karma..."

text.content: "Yes, this is fate." The Tianji Record's voice gradually faded, "Breaker of fate, your path is still long. The Heavenly Eye will not sit by as you grow. Every step ahead will be a lethal trap."

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji) "I understand. Since I chose this path, I never intended to turn back."

text.content: Chen Ji opened his eyes and found himself still standing in the same place, but everything around him had changed. He could see the threads of fate flowing in the air, hear the faint pulse of destiny. And deep in his Mental Sea, the light of the Tianji Record was slowly circulating, fusing with his soul as one.

At that moment, an old yet familiar voice rang in his ears—that was Mo Xiansheng's voice, yet clearer than ever before: "Breaker of fate, the death deadline of Chapter 700 cannot be escaped. But you have already gained the power to rewrite it—may you find the true path to breaking fate at destiny's end."

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji) "The death deadline of Chapter 700... Hmph, I, Chen Ji, never believes in fate. The Heavenly Eye wants to kill me? Then let it try."

text.content: Chen Ji sensed the全新的力量 flowing through his body, his heart filled with both anticipation and heaviness. The awakening of the Tianji Record had shown him hope to break the fetters of destiny, but the weighty karmic cost also made him deeply aware of the difficulty ahead.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji) "But before that, I still have 700 chapters of time to strategize. Come, let me see what possibilities this complete Tianji Record can bring me."

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze blazing like fire. He knew that from this moment, his chess game against the Heavenly Eye had truly begun. And in the place invisible to him, those Heavenly Eyes were also watching him, waiting for the moment he made a fatal mistake.

The awakening of the Tianji Record was complete, and the chess game of destiny turned a new page. Chen Ji clenched his fists, feeling that heavy karmic force circulating within his body. He knew that from now on, every step would be a生死之局.
But he showed not a trace of fear. Having been a废物 for so long, having played the pig to eat the tiger for so long, now it was time to let the world see exactly how far this Chen Ji could go.
